description: This file provides utility functions for creating mock HTTP request and response objects for testing purposes in a Node.js environment, such as making base requests, simulating stalled requests, and constructing form bodies.

methods.name: export function makeBaseReq( makeBaseReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object with specified method and options, with a custom destroy method and default URL.

methods.description: Creates a base request that does not emit 'data' or 'end', simulating a stalled request.

methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with custom _status and _body properties, and a getter/setter for statusCode.
